criteria.label: Presentation
criteria.passStandard: Cohesive, detailed and readable presentation appropriate to its genre. Comparable 3D games must demonstrate substantial model, material, lighting and environmental craft. Intentional 2D/stylized work can meet the standard through art direction, animation, interface and scene craft; dimensionality alone does not pass or fail.
criteria.adequateEvidence: Inspect representative real gameplay imagery/footage, not logos, generated mockups or promotional covers. State scene/build limits. Screenshot inspection establishes presentation only.

criteria.label: Gameplay depth
criteria.passStandard: Substantial coherent core loop with meaningful choices, challenge and progression or replayability appropriate to its genre; more than a one-mechanic technical demonstration. Feature counts and length alone do not establish depth.
criteria.adequateEvidence: Observed gameplay, substantial creator gameplay footage, an inspectable implemented loop, a substantive independent review, or a detailed operational walkthrough corroborated by actual gameplay imagery or source evidence. Documentation-based passes have medium confidence. Marketing feature lists and genre tags alone are insufficient.

criteria.label: Controls and polish
criteria.passStandard: Responsive understandable controls; readable feedback/interface; coherent onboarding/transitions; no recurring friction undermining play. Judge actual supported device, not presumed mobile compatibility.
criteria.adequateEvidence: Hands-on interaction or substantive independent review evaluating controls/feedback on an identified edition/platform. Merely listing supported controls is insufficient.

criteria.label: Completeness
criteria.passStandard: Satisfying usable game within promised scope: sustained loop or appropriate campaign/outcome, restart/recovery and applicable save/progression. Alpha is not automatic failure. A Released tag or downloadable build alone is not proof. Sandboxes do not require narrative endings.
criteria.adequateEvidence: Observed complete loop/session or substantive independent review corroborated by current release scope, describing available/incomplete and recoverable portions.

criteria.label: Stability
criteria.passStandard: Core play, transitions and applicable saving/reloading work reliably on assessed platform/build without material crashes, softlocks, lost progress or severe performance failures. Other builds/devices do not inherit this judgment.
criteria.adequateEvidence: Bounded meaningful gameplay session or substantive independent test/review on an identified build/platform. Headless tests, HTTP200, source availability, crowd ratings and absence of bug reports alone do not qualify.

statusDefinitions.pass: Adequate criterion-specific evidence shows the standard met.
statusDefinitions.partial: Adequate evidence shows mixed quality: substantive requirements met and others below standard. Not a synonym for incomplete evidence.
statusDefinitions.fail: Adequate evidence shows the standard unmet; explain observed defect.
statusDefinitions.unknown: Absent, inadequate, build-mismatched or insufficient evidence. Never scored as failure.

aggregation.incompleteDisplay: No overall star rating; show criteriaMet, assessedCriteria and missing criteria.
aggregation.confidence: Evidence strength and build/platform specificity, not metadata coverage or popularity.
aggregation.qualitySort: Criteria met descending across complete/provisional; confidence then completeness as tie-breakers, then relevance/title. Not an incomparable final quality ranking. Editorial showcase is separately selected.
aggregation.completeScopeRequirement: All five adequately assessed criteria must share a compatible identified build/platform; otherwise remain provisional with an explicit scope mismatch. Derivative/scenario assessments never become whole-original ratings.

qualityBands.below-standard: No criteria met in a complete assessment
qualityBands.2-star: Two criteria met; limited overall quality
qualityBands.3-star: Three criteria met; worthwhile strengths with material limitations
qualityBands.4-star: Four criteria met; strong with a clearly identified weakness
qualityBands.5-star: All five criteria met; strongest qualified games

priorityPolicy: Substantial cross-genre candidates first based on real game evidence and published presentation and depth standards. Evidence availability organizes work only, never raises quality scores. Preserve access/maturity/content filters separately.

showcaseEligibility.note: Editorial showcase selection requires substantive presentation and depth evidence and no known material control/stability failure. A generic four-of-five score does not override weak graphics or shallow gameplay. Provisional status stays visible.

calibration.rule: Inspected substantial game imagery may establish scoped presentation, but does not automatically award all five criteria or validate a derivative.
Startup, legal moves and passing automation do not establish substantial presentation, a meaningful finished game experience or overall five-star quality.
A functioning prototype, metadata completeness or work-in-progress label does not establish polished presentation or substantial gameplay depth.

operationalWalkthroughException.requires: Specific operational systems/decisions, corroborated by inspected actual gameplay imagery or implemented source, not a marketing feature list. Presentation need not pass: visual quality and mechanics are independent criteria. Never qualifies control or stability passes.
